facts.text: The snowman that appears at the door
facts.why: Max points out a snowman in the yard that nobody built. The transcript has it in the yard, not at the door.
facts.fix: The snowman that appears in the yard

facts.text: Eaten before the snowman turns up outside.
facts.why: Max tells his mum there is a snowman in the yard that nobody built, so it does turn up outside during the blackout.

vibe.verdict: Right house, right family and a good snow globe poster, but the writing is cosy where the film is mean.
